# orch8_sequence (Resource)

One version of an Orch8 sequence (workflow definition). Sequence versions are immutable in the engine (`POST /sequences` creates, there is no update), so any change replaces the resource. To roll out a new version without deleting the old one, create a second `orch8_sequence` with a bumped `version` and use `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }`. Deleting fails while non-terminal instances still reference the version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A sequence version is immutable. Bump `version` to publish a new one.
resource "orch8_sequence" "welcome" {
  name    = "welcome-email"
  version = 1
  definition = jsonencode({
    input_schema = {
      type       = "object"
      required   = ["email"]
      properties = { email = { type = "string" } }
    }
    blocks = [
      {
        type    = "step"
        id      = "send"
        handler = "http_request"
        params = {
          method = "POST"
          url    = "https://mail.example.com/send"
          body   = { to = "{{ context.data.email }}", template = "welcome" }
        }
      }
    ]
  })
}

# Or load the same JSON you run locally with `orch8 dev`:
# definition = file("${path.module}/sequence.json")
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `definition` (String) JSON object with the sequence body: `blocks` (required) and optionally `input_schema`, `interceptors`, `sla`, `on_failure`, `on_cancel`, `schema_version`, `status`. Identity keys (`name`, `namespace`, `tenant_id`, `version`) may be present only if they match the attributes; `id`/`created_at` are assigned by the provider. Typically `file("sequence.json")` or `jsonencode({...})`.
- `name` (String) Sequence name.
- `version` (Number) Sequence version number (unique per tenant/namespace/name).

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Namespace. Defaults to `default`.
- `tenant_id` (String) Owning tenant. Defaults to the provider's tenant_id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `deprecated` (Boolean) Whether this version is deprecated.
- `id` (String) Sequence version UUID (generated by the provider, UUIDv7).
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status reported by the engine (draft, staging, production, unpublished).
- `warnings` (List of String) Lint / template / unknown-field warnings returned by the engine at creation.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by sequence version UUID.
terraform import orch8_sequence.welcome 0194d2e6-7f44-7e2a-9c3e-1a2b3c4d5e6f
```
